top_signals.title: Wolf: Currency Weakness, Intervention Lift Gold Flows
top_signals.summary: Gold has been up around 14% in August, bullion given fresh impetus by the US Treasury's unexpected intervention in the bond market. Guy Wolf, Global Head of Market Analytics at Marex spoke to Bloomberg's Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the reason that is helping gold rise. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: Bitcoin and crypto joined US stock markets in fresh gains after Nvidia Q2 earnings beat expectations by around $4 billion.

top_signals.title: Nepal Billionaire: Rebuilding After Flood to Cost $5B
top_signals.summary: Binod Chaudhary, Chairman & President of Chaudhary Group, says efforts to rebuild Nepal’s infrastructure after a devastating flash flood this week could cost at least $5 billion. He also said the amount his group will be spending on this effort will be higher than it did in 2015, when a deadly earthquake had sparked similar nationwide reconstruction work. He appeared exclusively on Bloomberg's "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Source: Bloomberg)
